Scoped deliberately: the Data_Layer only ever touches its own single table

ResourceComment: Both real Nova Sonic ids. Note the v2 model is 'amazon.nova-2-sonic-v1:0',
NOT 'amazon.nova-sonic-v2:0' — the latter does not exist, and granting it
instead of the real v2 id fails the voice path with AccessDeniedException.
These must match strands NOVA_SONIC_V1_MODEL_ID / NOVA_SONIC_V2_MODEL_ID.

SidComment: Human handover into Amazon Connect. Omit this statement entirely unless
CLINIC_CONNECT_INSTANCE_ID is set — the agent records escalations without
it and simply does not claim anyone was reached.
StartTaskContact queues a work item carrying the escalation as contact
attributes and needs no phone number. StartOutboundVoiceContact places a
real callback and additionally needs a claimed source number and the
destination country permitted on the instance.
Deliberately grants no connect:CreateInstance, no user administration and
no contact-flow editing: the agent participates in a contact centre, it
does not configure one.
Replace CONNECT_INSTANCE_ID, or drop this statement.
The human handover's voice, in both directions.
Polly speaks what the doctor types to the caller, and speaks the line that
tells a caller nobody was able to pick up. This was missing, and the
failure was invisible: synthesis errors are caught so a dead voice can
never drop a call, so on the deployed instance the typed handover and the
nobody-picked-up apology were silently doing nothing a caller could hear -
the dead air the apology exists to prevent. Found in the log as three
'Polly synthesis failed' warnings.
Transcribe turns the doctor's spoken words into transcript turns while she
holds the call, so the written record is not blank for the part a human
actually handled.
Neither action supports resource-level permissions, hence Resource: *.
Both are scoped to synthesis and streaming recognition only: no voice
management, no custom vocabularies, no batch jobs reading S3.
Two prefixes, both in CLINIC_RECORDINGS_BUCKET / CLINIC_DOCUMENTS_BUCKET.
call-recordings/ is call audio, written only when CLINIC_RECORDINGS_BUCKET
is set. clinic-documents/ holds the clinic briefing the agent reads at the
start of every session — without GetObject on it the call still connects
but the agent answers with no knowledge of the clinic.
Deliberately grants no s3:DeleteObject: audio is expired by a bucket
lifecycle rule, not by the application.
Replace RECORDINGS_BUCKET.
Only needed when recordings use SSE-KMS (CLINIC_RECORDINGS_SSE=aws:kms).
Replace REGION, ACCOUNT_ID, and KMS_KEY_ID, or drop this statement when
using the default AES256 (S3-managed) encryption.
